records.subject: Bob Menendez

records.subject: Bob Menendez
records.label: Indicted by SDNY on bribery conspiracy - cash and gold bars in exchange for using his office to benefit three NJ businessmen and the government of Egypt; later charged with acting as a foreign agent of Egypt

records.subject: Bob Menendez
records.label: FBI search recovered roughly $480,000 in cash (some stuffed in envelopes and clothing) and gold bars at his home, per the indictment

records.subject: Bob Menendez
records.label: Dozens of fellow Democrats, including Sen. John Fetterman and N.J. Gov. Phil Murphy, publicly called on him to resign after the 2023 indictment

records.subject: Bob Menendez
records.label: Maintained his innocence, saying the cash was personal savings from his family and not bribe money; "I have been, throughout my whole life, someone who saves cash"

records.subject: Bob Menendez
records.label: Convicted at trial on all 16 counts, including bribery, extortion, obstruction of justice, and acting as a foreign agent

records.subject: Bob Menendez
records.label: Resigned from the U.S. Senate effective Aug 20, 2024, weeks after the conviction

records.subject: Bob Menendez
records.label: Sentenced to 11 years in federal prison
